<a name="memberEnhancer"></a>

## memberEnhancer(name, hof, options, args) ⇒ <code>(member: AnyFunction, memberName: string) &#x3D;&gt; AnyFunction</code>
The shared skeleton of a member decorator: it validates the factory call
(the paren-less misfire guard), captures the option bag, and returns the
function that enhances one member — checking the member's async-ness against
the guard before handing it to the HOF.

Every member converter (`decorateMethod`, `decorateGetter`) shares this,
so the misfire and guard rules are defined once.

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: <code>(member: AnyFunction, memberName: string) &#x3D;&gt; AnyFunction</code> - The function that enhances one member.  

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| name | <code>string</code> | The converter's name, used in the error messages. |
| hof | <code>(fn: any, hofOptions?: any) &#x3D;&gt; any</code> | The converted HOF. |
| options | <code>DecoratorGuard</code> | The converter's guard options. |
| args | <code>unknown[]</code> | The arguments the decorator factory received. |
